title: agent-sandbox + tools-sandbox modes
description:
Add agent-sandbox and tools-sandbox placement modes per docs/plans/21-serve-orchestrator.md §2.4-2.5, §3.5, §6 Bead 2.

Required reading: docs/plans/21-serve-orchestrator.md

Key deliverables:
- agent-sandbox creation flow (reuses proxy logic from Bead 1, just different SandboxControl — NodeSandboxControl or FleetSandboxControl)
- tools-sandbox creation flow: in-process AgentLoopService with SandboxBackend ToolEnvironment, including:
  - resolveToolsSandboxHostAddr() — Node uses configured --sandbox-host-addr, Fleet uses CreateSandboxResponse.Address
  - extractHostLocalSessionID() — strips fleet: prefix for host-local session ID
  - Export fleet.ParseSandboxID() from internal/sandbox/control/fleet/
  - Dual ID tracking: sandboxID (full prefixed) + toolSessionID (host-local)
  - Compensation cleanup: destroy sandbox on AgentLoopService.CreateSession failure
- Pause/resume logic for all three modes, including lossy-pause handling for agent-direct
- Config validation for sandbox-host connectivity
- Explicit Node(1 host)/Fleet(N hosts) selection in buildNodeOrFleetControl()
- Unit tests for agent-sandbox and tools-sandbox flows
- Unit tests for Fleet sandbox ID extraction (host-local vs fleet-prefixed)
- Unit tests for Node vs Fleet host address resolution
- Unit tests for pause/resume with mock SandboxControl

Depends on: Bead 1 (core orchestrator + agent-direct)
